from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u034/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    marker=None
    for color,cells in comps:
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        top,bottom=min(ys),max(ys); left,right=min(xs),max(xs)
        # The marker is a vertical stroke from the top edge, with a crossbar at its lower end.
        if top!=0 or bottom<3 or right-left<2: continue
        stemx=min(xs,key=lambda x: sum(1 for y,xx in cells if xx!=x))
        stemrows={y for y,x in cells if x==stemx}
        if len(stemrows)<4 or min(stemrows)!=0 or max(stemrows)!=bottom: continue
        armxs={x for y,x in cells if y==bottom}
        if len(armxs)<3 or stemx not in armxs: continue
        direction=1 if max(armxs)>stemx else -1
        marker=(color,cells,bottom,stemx,direction)
        break
    if marker is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mcolor,mcells,elbow_y,stemx,direction=marker
    candidates=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color==mcolor: continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        if max(xs)>=stemx: continue
        # Objects on the left of the marker; favor an object crossing its elbow row,
        # then the one closest horizontally to the stem.
        row_gap=0 if min(ys)<=elbow_y<=max(ys) else min(abs(elbow_y-min(ys)),abs(elbow_y-max(ys)))
        horiz_gap=stemx-max(xs)
        if direction<0:
            # For a left-facing crossbar, the selected object is below the elbow.
            if min(ys)<=elbow_y: continue
            row_gap=min(ys)-elbow_y
        candidates.append(((row_gap,horiz_gap),cells,color))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,target,tcolor=min(candidates,key=lambda z:z[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in target: out[y][x]=mcolor
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((color,cells))
    marker=None
    for color,cells in comps:
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        top,bottom=min(ys),max(ys); left,right=min(xs),max(xs)
        # The marker is a vertical stroke from the top edge, with a crossbar at its lower end.
        if top!=0 or bottom<3 or right-left<2: continue
        stemx=min(xs,key=lambda x: sum(1 for y,xx in cells if xx!=x))
        stemrows={y for y,x in cells if x==stemx}
        if len(stemrows)<4 or min(stemrows)!=0 or max(stemrows)!=bottom: continue
        armxs={x for y,x in cells if y==bottom}
        if len(armxs)<3 or stemx not in armxs: continue
        direction=1 if max(armxs)>stemx else -1
        marker=(color,cells,bottom,stemx,direction)
        break
    if marker is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mcolor,mcells,elbow_y,stemx,direction=marker
    candidates=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color==mcolor: continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        if max(xs)>=stemx: continue
        # Objects on the left of the marker; favor an object crossing its elbow row,
        # then the one closest horizontally to the stem.
        row_gap=0 if min(ys)<=elbow_y<=max(ys) else min(abs(elbow_y-min(ys)),abs(elbow_y-max(ys)))
        horiz_gap=stemx-max(xs)
        if direction<0:
            # For a left-facing crossbar, the selected object is below the elbow.
            if min(ys)<=elbow_y: continue
            row_gap=min(ys)-elbow_y
        candidates.append(((row_gap,horiz_gap),cells,color))
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    if direction < 0:
        _,target,tcolor=min(candidates,key=lambda z:(z[0][1],-len(z[1])))
    else:
        below=[z for z in candidates if min(y for y,x in z[1]) > elbow_y]
        if below:
            _,target,tcolor=min(below,key=lambda z:(min(y for y,x in z[1])-elbow_y,stemx-max(x for y,x in z[1])))
        else:
            _,target,tcolor=min(candidates,key=lambda z:z[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in target: out[y][x]=mcolor
    return out
